We are looking for an AI Engineer / Data Scientist in full remote to develop and enhance an intelligent matching engine that connects job seekers' profiles with relevant job opportunities and training programmes.

The solution will be integrated into the organisation's Microsoft Dynamics CRM platform and progressively replace existing matching tools.
Key responsibilities

• Design, develop and improve AI-powered matching, scoring and recommendation algorithms using Python.

• Build data ingestion and processing pipelines using Microsoft Fabric.

• Implement semantic search and indexing capabilities with Azure AI Search.

• Leverage Azure AI Foundry to develop and deploy AI solutions.

• Implement fuzzy matching, reranking and recommendation mechanisms.

• Deploy applications using Docker, Azure App Service and CI/CD pipelines.

• Develop APIs and connectors for integration with Microsoft Dynamics CRM and other business applications.

• Ensure data quality, security, monitoring and regulatory compliance.

• Design and execute tests to evaluate the accuracy and relevance of matching results.

• Support production deployments, technical documentation and knowledge transfer.

• Python

• Microsoft Fabric

• Azure AI Foundry

• Azure AI Search

• Semantic Search & Indexing

• Fuzzy Matching

• Docker

• Azure App Service

• API Development & Integration

• CI/CD and Cloud Deployment

Looking for a part-time job where you can work independently and take on real responsibility? 
Do you enjoy working in a refined, stylish setting, and take pride in cleanliness and order?
 

For our two charming hotels in Eeklo — Boutique Hotel Shamon and Aparthotel Acacia — we are looking for a permanent housekeeping team member who helps deliver a flawless and warm guest experience.
 

You'll join a small team where trust, independence, and responsibility are central. You'll be responsible for the overall cleanliness and thorough cleaning of the rooms and the hotel, working independently most of the time. 

 

What will you do?
 
 

• Thoroughly clean and make up the hotel rooms 

• Clean bathrooms and common areas 

• Change bed linen and towels 

• Restock hotel supplies 

• Check cleanliness and quality, including in rooms you didn't clean yourself 

• Maintain hallways, stairs, and shared spaces 

• Occasionally help out with breakfast (clearing tables, light prep) 
 

• You work independently, take responsibility, and have a strong sense of accountability 

• You notice what needs to be done: even during quiet moments, you look around and take initiative

jobs.occupation: Night CE truck driver for live poultry transport
jobs.description:
Job description 

As a vital link in our transport team, you safely collect and deliver poultry while the world sleeps. You will enjoy quiet, traffic-free roads throughout your shift, moving between different locations from Sunday evening to Friday morning. Using your forklift, you handle the loading and unloading of containers with care and precision. This role offers you true independence and responsibility as you manage one to three transport runs each night, ensuring everything is ready for your colleagues when your shift ends.

You will experience the freedom of night driving in a supportive, family-like environment where your contributions are truly valued. Your daily work is diverse, keeping you active and engaged while you take pride in maintaining your truck in top condition. If you appreciate a peaceful workspace without the rush-hour stress, this position is a perfect fit. We look forward to welcoming you to our team, where your professional work ethic makes a real difference in our daily operations.

 Requirements 

    
• Maintain a responsible and professional attitude while driving.
    
• Comfortable working in an environment with industry-related odours.
    
• Experience operating a truck-mounted forklift (kooiaap) is a strong advantage.
    
• Effective communication skills in Dutch, English, or French.

-

Are you eager to help manage and optimise our data centre infrastructure? Do you have experience with electricity, HVAC, fire safety, security and/or project management?

• You coordinate initiated projects, monitor and evaluate external parties involved in these projects
• You prepare and manage documentation related to the specifications of technical installations
• You oversee and optimise maintenance activities to ensure the correct operation of technical installations

Day-to-day bookkeeping: booking incoming and outgoing payments and matching them against bank statements.
 

Billing and credit control: issuing customer invoices, monitoring open receivables and following up 
 on

- 
 First experience in accounting (min. 2 years), either in a company or at an accounting office
 

- 
 Fluent in Dutch and English

 Degree in accounting or a related field

 Knowledge of the logistics or transport sector is an asset, but not a requirement

jobs.occupation: Production Line Supervisor Slicing | 2-Shift System | Oudenaarde
jobs.description:
Your Challenge

As a Production Line Supervisor, you are the driving force behind a smoothly operating production line. You combine leadership with a hands-on approach and ensure that quality, safety, and efficiency remain top priorities.

What will you do?

• Lead and oversee a modern production line within the High Care department.

• Manage, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 9 employees.

• Foster a positive working atmosphere and encourage strong teamwork.

• Actively participate in the production process while monitoring quality and productivity.

• Identify areas for improvement and contribute ideas for process optimization.

• Troubleshoot and resolve minor technical issues to minimize downtime.

• Ensure a smooth and accurate handover during shift changes.

• Maintain compliance with quality, safety, and hygiene standards.

Who Are We Looking For?

You are someone who enjoys taking responsibility and gets energy from leading people and improving processes.

Your Profile

• You have experience supervising employees in a production environment.

• You possess strong communication and people-management skills.

• You have solid technical knowledge and can independently solve minor technical issues on a production line.

• You are fluent in Dutch and can communicate effectively in English.

• Knowledge of Polish and/or Bulgarian is considered an asset.

• Your educational background is less important than your willingness to learn and grow.

• You are mature, flexible, stress-resistant, and able to work independently.

• You take ownership of your responsibilities and lead by example.

Are you an experienced Wintel System Engineer with a passion for Microsoft infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments? Do you enjoy taking technical ownership, solving complex infrastructure challenges and helping customers modernize their IT environments?

At Inetum, we're looking for a hands-on Wintel System Engineer to strengthen our infrastructure expertise and support our customers in transforming and optimizing their Microsoft environments.

In this role, you'll work on challenging infrastructure projects, with a strong focus on Windows Server technologies, Active Directory, SQL Server platforms and hybrid cloud environments.

You'll be involved in the entire project lifecycle, from technical analysis and planning to implementation, migration, validation and documentation.

Your key responsibilities:

• Design, implement, maintain and optimize Microsoft-based infrastructure environments.
• Lead and execute end-to-end server migrations, including Windows Server upgrades and infrastructure modernization projects.
• Manage and migrate Active Directory environments, including domain migrations, DNS, DHCP, Group Policies and authentication services.
• Implement and support Microsoft SQL Server environments, including platform upgrades, Always On Availability Groups and Windows Failover Clustering.
• Perform application and file server migrations, ensuring business continuity and minimal downtime.
• Work with hybrid infrastructure environments, combining on-premises Microsoft technologies with cloud-based solutions.
• Prepare and execute migration strategies, including cutover planning, rollback scenarios and post-migration validation.
• Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and provide sustainable technical solutions.
• Collaborate directly with customers, understand their technical requirements and take ownership of project delivery.
• Deliver clear technical documentation, as-built documentation and knowledge transfer to operational teams.
You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking responsibility for your projects while collaborating with specialized experts whenever specific technical challenges require additional expertise.

Do you have a strong technical background in Microsoft infrastructure and several years of hands-on experience?

Your technical expertise includes:

• Windows Server: Extensive experience with Windows Server 2016, 2019, 2022 and preferably 2025.
• Active Directory: Strong knowledge of AD DS, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) and FSMO roles.
• Security & Authentication: Understanding of Kerberos, service accounts, authentication mechanisms and Microsoft PKI / Certificate Services.
• SQL Server: Experience with SQL Server 2019/2022, Always On Availability Groups and SQL platform migrations.
• High Availability: Knowledge of Windows Failover Clustering and business-critical infrastructure environments.
• Microsoft Infrastructure Services: Experience with IIS, File Services, DFS, NTFS permissions, Remote Desktop Services (RDS) and RemoteApp.
• Virtualization: Operational knowledge of VMware vSphere.
• Hybrid Cloud: Good understanding of hybrid Microsoft infrastructure environments and their integration with cloud technologies.
• Migration Projects: Proven experience with end-to-end server, domain, application and file server migrations.
• Project Delivery: Experience with migration planning, cutover execution, rollback strategies, technical validation and documentation.
And are you…

• An experienced Wintel Engineer with approximately 5–10+ years of relevant experience?
• A hands-on technical expert who enjoys taking ownership from start to finish?
• Comfortable independently managing complex infrastructure migrations?
• Strong in troubleshooting, root cause analysis and problem-solving?
• Someone who combines technical expertise with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset?
• A clear communicator who enjoys working directly with customers and technical stakeholders?
• Structured in your approach, with attention to documentation, knowledge sharing and quality?
• A team player who knows when to involve specialized expertise?
• Fluent in Dutch and English, with French as an additional asset?
Then you might be the Wintel System Engineer we're looking for!
